name: recordings
description: Speech-to-text recording store for AI coding agents. CLI + MCP + HTTP API (recordings-serve) + generated SDK. The server's data backend is a two-value switch, HASNA_RECORDINGS_STORAGE_MODE=sqlite|postgresql (a HASNA_RECORDINGS_DATABASE_URL implies postgresql); on postgresql the serve process reads/writes that database directly with API-key auth via @hasna/contracts. The client is a separate two-value switch, HASNA_RECORDINGS_CLIENT_STORE=sqlite|http, and never opens Postgres.
